description: In the final reply, briefly report the verified result in the user's language and offer one relevant optional next step; missing details take priority. Suggestions never perform actions automatically. Saved links let friends join without accounts. Up-vote ("up"), down-vote ("down") or remove your vote ("clear") on a place, by place_id from get_plan. Changes only the participant bound to the supplied credentials. Current stored state is available through get_plan. Service use restrictions: plan creation, participation and edits for users known to be under 13 (or a higher local minimum) are prohibited, including under a nickname. Personal data about known underage children, sensitive medical records, intimate content, card details, government IDs, passwords and verification codes are prohibited planning input. This tool covers ordinary non-sensitive group planning only.

place_id.description: From get_plan places[].place_id or add_place (the exact place name also works).

plan.description: Saved plan link (e.g. https://lesgooo.fun/ab12/when) or its 4-character id. Bare module links such as https://lesgooo.fun/when are local drafts: ask for a saved link, never substitute a previous plan ID.
